scripts.precompute:all: for p in roof nose side rear corner flat; do node tools/sim/precompute.mjs preset=$p dur=6.5 hz=100 & done; wait
scripts.test: npm run spec:check && npm run flight:parity && npm run test:py
scripts.flight:sim:all: node tools/sim/flight.mjs preset=nose controller=ap out=soft dur=8 & node tools/sim/flight.mjs preset=roof controller=ap out=recover dur=8 & node tools/sim/flight.mjs preset=roof controller=ap out=hard dur=8 armDelay=0.6 & wait
scripts.film:install: node tools/film/film.mjs program=install out=renders/安装_冷气喷口_1080p.mp4 w=1920 h=1080 fps=30 samples=16
scripts.film:roll: node tools/film/film.mjs program=flight q=run=mpc-roll out=renders/飞出_跳跃横滚360_1080p.mp4 w=1920 h=1080 fps=30 samples=16
scripts.film:stop: node tools/film/film.mjs program=flight q=run=mpc-stop-nose out=renders/飞出_落地刹车转向_1080p.mp4 w=1920 h=1080 fps=30 samples=16
scripts.film:flight: node tools/film/film.mjs program=flight q=run=soft out=renders/飞出_软着陆_1080p.mp4 w=1920 h=1080 fps=30 samples=16 && node tools/film/film.mjs program=flight q=run=hard out=renders/飞出_硬着陆_1080p.mp4 w=1920 h=1080 fps=30 samples=16
